scenarios.name: black-mana-unavailable-without-swamp
scenarios.why: The black-or-red ability requires control of a Swamp; the Peak alone does not meet that condition.

scenarios.name: black-mana-offered-with-swamp
scenarios.why: Controlling a Swamp satisfies the printed condition for the black-or-red mana ability.

scenarios.name: black-mana-activates-with-swamp
scenarios.why: With a Swamp controlled, the ability is legal; activating it taps the Peak and adds black mana.

scenarios.name: colorless-mana-activates-unrestricted
scenarios.why: The colorless-producing ability carries no restriction; activating it taps the Peak and adds colorless mana with no Swamp controlled.
